summary: Assemble a reproducible release candidate and a bounded rollout plan.

inputs.description: Observed integrated revision, base, verification, and outstanding work.

inputs.description: Checks and evidence bound to the exact candidate and inputs.

completion_checks: Release contents and executable artifacts are bound to immutable identities.
The target, rollout gates, abort conditions, owners, and data-compatible recovery path are explicit.
failure_modes: Missing required inputs, capability, or authority: blocked; retain a concrete next action.
Contradictory or insufficient evidence: inconclusive; never report an unobserved outcome as passed.
A demonstrated violation of a required condition: failed; preserve reproducible evidence.
